# pi-harness-delegate

> A pi coding agent extension that delegates work to Claude Code, Codex (Muse), OpenCode, Amp and Devin headlessly — one tool, normalized permissions, multi-harness fan-out, host-run verify, streaming transcripts and portable templates.

## Links

- [Website](https://yorch.github.io/pi-harness-delegate/): overview, harnesses, usage, modes, config
- [Source and README](https://github.com/yorch/pi-harness-delegate): full documentation
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pi-harness-delegate): `pi install npm:pi-harness-delegate`
- [pi.dev listing](https://pi.dev/packages/pi-harness-delegate)
- [Changelog](https://github.com/yorch/pi-harness-delegate/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
